$comment: Every shop-specific value in one file. Written by `npm run setup`; nothing here should be hand-edited on a real shop. Ships with the demonstration shop's values and isTemplate:true, so a fresh clone runs and looks finished while saying out loud that the products are not yours.

brand.tagline: Fine watches, sold by people who repair them.
brand.announcement: Insured worldwide delivery · Every reference authenticated in-house

categories.blurb: Round cases, printed dials, nothing shouting.
Smaller cases, set indices, quartz and automatic.
Alligator and calf, stitched by hand.
Set stones and solid cases, finished by hand.

hero.$comment: mode 'photo' uses a lifestyle photograph with hotspot coordinates measured by eye against that specific file — it cannot be generated for another shop. mode 'slides' is the portable default `npm run setup` writes. mode 'plate' drops the slider when no product has an image that reads at hero size.
hero.alt: A couple in evening dress, each wearing a steel watch
